exercises.instruction: Write two sentences for each situation. Use needn't have in the first sentence and could have in the second (as in the example). For could have, see Unit 27.

items.prompt: Why did you rush? Why didn't you take your time?
answers: You needn't have rushed. You could have taken your time.

items.prompt: Why did you walk home? Why didn't you take a taxi?
answers: You needn't have walked home. You could have taken a taxi.

items.prompt: Why did they stay at a hotel? Why didn't they stay with us?
answers: They needn't have stayed at a hotel. They could have stayed with us.

items.prompt: Why did she phone me at 3 am? Why didn't she wait until the morning?
answers: She needn't have phoned me at 3 am. She could have waited until the morning.

items.prompt: Why did you shout at me? Why weren't you more patient?
answers: You needn't have shouted at me. You could have been more patient.
